name: ValueMax Group Limited
summary: ValueMax Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the pawnbroking, moneylending, jewelry and watches retailing, and gold trading businesses primarily in Singapore. It operates through four segments: Pawnbroking, Retail and Trading of Jewelry and Gold, Moneylending, and Other Operations. It offers pawn broking services through pledging jewelry in yellow or white gold, diamond jewelry, and branded timepieces, as well as gold, platinum, or silver bars and coins. The company also provides secured and unsecured term loans for businessmen and corporates; and hire purchase and floor stock financing services for automotive industry.
